spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile standing on a small patch of rocky ground. It has the overall size and proportions of a small, stocky horse or pony. The head, neck, lower legs, and tail are covered in shaggy brown fur with a horse-like appearance, while the entire torso, back, sides, and belly are bare and covered in thick, warty, mottled skin in dark blue-grey, brown, and pale cream with many raised bumps. The boundary between the furry and bare areas is abrupt at the base of the neck, the chest, and the upper legs. The animal stands on four legs and has a long, hairy tail at the rear.

parts.looks_like: two upright, pointed, furry brown horse ears with darker inner edges
parts.where: on top of the head, one slightly behind the other

parts.looks_like: thick, shaggy, uneven brown fur with darker streaks, longer and coarser than the body fur
parts.where: running along the top of the neck from just behind the ears down to the shoulders

parts.looks_like: four sturdy, columnar, horse-like legs covered in long shaggy brown fur with visible joints at the knee/hock
parts.where: two forelegs under the chest and two hind legs under the rump, supporting the body

parts.looks_like: four single, rounded, dark brown hooves with a hard outer wall
parts.where: at the bottom tip of each leg, in contact with the ground

parts.looks_like: a long, straight, dense horse tail made of long brown hair
parts.where: hanging down from the rump at the rear left of the body

parts.looks_like: bare, thick, amphibian-like skin with a bumpy, warty texture, not fur or feathers; dark mottled blue-grey and brown on the back and sides fading to pale cream and wrinkled on the belly, covered in many small and large raised round tubercles
parts.where: covering the entire torso, back, flanks, and underbelly between the furry neck/chest and the furry upper legs

parts.looks_like: irregular mottled patches of dark grey, blue, brown, and off-white on the bare skin, plus scattered light and dark wart-like spots
parts.where: across the bare skin of the back, sides, and belly

meta_spark.description: A four-legged horse-like animal standing in side view facing right on rocky ground. Its head, neck, legs and hindquarters are covered in shaggy brown fur with a long horse-like muzzle, upright pointed ears, a short mane along the neck, four slender legs ending in dark hooves, and a long flowing tail at the rear. The middle of its torso from behind the shoulders to the hips is hairless and covered in dark blue-gray mottled skin with many small raised bumps and warts, fading to pale cream on the belly.
